title: Inspection frequency
sum: Visual inspections must be done at the intervals required for the system type and components.

title: Testing frequency
sum: Periodic functional testing of devices and circuits at the required intervals.

title: Notification before testing
sum: Notify the monitoring company and AHJ before testing that may send signals.

title: Visual inspection of devices
sum: Devices must be visually inspected for condition, mounting, and obvious damage or obstruction.

title: Sensitivity testing of smoke detectors
sum: Smoke detector sensitivity must be tested within the listed range; dirty detectors often fail.

title: Smoke detector cleaning
sum: Detectors outside sensitivity limits must be cleaned or replaced and retested.

title: Heat detector testing
sum: Restorable heat detectors require functional heat testing; nonrestorable types follow the listed method.

title: Manual fire alarm box testing
sum: Pull stations must operate, send the correct signal, and be accessible and in good condition.

title: Waterflow device testing
sum: Waterflow switches must initiate an alarm within the required time when flow is simulated.

title: Valve supervisory device testing
sum: Tamper switches must report supervisory when the valve is moved from normal.

title: Notification appliance testing
sum: Horns, strobes, and speakers must produce the required audible/visible output and sync where required.

title: Interface / control module testing
sum: Monitor and control modules must correctly report or control the connected circuit or equipment.

title: Control unit testing
sum: FACP functions, power supplies, and trouble/supervisory handling must be verified.

title: Battery testing
sum: Secondary power batteries must be load-tested and replaced when capacity is insufficient.

title: Communicator / off-premises signaling
sum: Alarm, supervisory, and trouble signals must be received at the supervising station.

title: Maintenance
sum: Systems must be maintained so they operate as intended; deficiencies must be corrected.

title: Records
sum: Inspection, testing, and maintenance records must be kept and available to the AHJ.

title: Impairments
sum: System impairments must be managed with notifications, tags, and restoration procedures.

title: System response to alarm
sum: Alarm signals must be processed and notification appliances actuated as required.

title: Power supplies
sum: Primary and secondary power must meet capacity and transfer requirements.

title: Signal priority / distinct signals
sum: Alarm, supervisory, and trouble signals must be distinct and prioritized correctly.

title: Monitoring integrity of circuits
sum: Initiating and notification circuits must be supervised for integrity (opens/grounds).

title: Audible characteristics
sum: Audible notification must meet required sound level and intelligibility for the space.

title: Visible characteristics
sum: Strobe candela rating, spacing, and synchronization must match the protected area.

title: Textual / voice appliances
sum: Voice messages must be intelligible in the coverage area.

title: Initiating device general requirements
sum: Detectors and other initiating devices must be installed and located per listing and chapter rules.

title: Smoke detector location / spacing
sum: Smoke detector spacing and placement must provide coverage for the protected area.

title: Heat detector location / spacing
sum: Heat detector spacing and temperature rating must suit the ceiling and hazard.

title: Manual fire alarm boxes location
sum: Pull stations must be located at required exits and mounted at the correct height, unobstructed.

title: Manual box accessibility
sum: Manual stations must remain conspicuous and accessible; storage or décor must not block them.

title: Sprinkler waterflow devices
sum: Waterflow initiating devices must be installed so they detect flow from the sprinkler system.

title: Valve supervisory devices
sum: Control valves must be supervised so an off-normal position is reported.

title: Duct smoke detectors
sum: Duct detectors must be installed where required for air-handler shutdown and sampled correctly.

title: Audible notification appliance location
sum: Audible appliances must be placed to achieve required sound levels throughout the area.

title: Visible notification appliance location
sum: Visible appliances must cover the area per spacing tables and candela ratings.

title: Elevator recall / shutdown interfaces
sum: Fire alarm interfaces to elevator recall and power shutdown must function as required.

title: HVAC shutdown interfaces
sum: Duct detection or other interfaces must shut down HVAC as required by the design.

title: Door holder release
sum: Smoke doors on holders must release on alarm and close/latch fully.

title: Record of Completion
sum: A record of completion is required for new systems and modifications before final acceptance.

title: Record of Inspection & Testing
sum: Document inspection and testing results, including deficiencies and who performed the work.

title: Records retention
sum: Keep ITM records for the required retention period for AHJ review.

title: Inspections and tests documentation content
sum: Records should identify the system, date, results, deficiencies, and responsible parties.

title: Equipment listing / condition
sum: Fire alarm equipment must remain listed and in a condition that supports proper operation.

title: Impairment identification
sum: Impaired systems or circuits must be identified and the AHJ/monitoring service informed as required.

title: Notification appliance circuits
sum: NAC wiring and loading must support the appliances without overload or supervision faults.

title: Protected premises system performance
sum: The protected premises system must detect, notify, and process signals per the design.

title: SLC / addressable device performance
sum: Addressable devices must report the correct address and respond on the signaling line circuit.

title: Emergency communications systems
sum: ECS/MNS voice systems must deliver intelligible messages to required areas.

title: Where fire alarm systems are required
sum: International Fire Code requirements for when a fire alarm system must be provided.

title: Occupant notification systems
sum: Occupant notification must meet IFC audible/visible requirements for the occupancy.

title: Inspection, testing and maintenance (IFC)
sum: IFC requires fire alarm systems to be inspected, tested, and maintained under NFPA 72.

title: Systems out of service
sum: When a fire protection system is out of service, the IFC impairment procedures apply.

title: Inspection, testing and maintenance required
sum: Fire protection and life-safety systems must be maintained in an operative condition.

title: Fire alarm and detection systems (building code)
sum: Building-code provisions for fire alarm design and installation in new construction.

title: Sprinkler system supervision
sum: Automatic sprinkler systems require electronic supervision of valves and waterflow where required.

title: Deficiencies and corrections
sum: Deficiencies found during ITM must be corrected or reported per the owner's and AHJ's process.

title: System restored after testing
sum: After testing, the system must be restored to normal and supervising station notified.

title: Smoke detector accessibility for maintenance
sum: Detectors must remain accessible for inspection, testing, and cleaning.

title: Notification appliance mounting / condition
sum: Appliances must be securely mounted and free of damage that impairs output.

title: Alarm signal deactivation
sum: Silencing or disabling notification must follow required safeguards so the system is not left impaired unnoticed.

title: Initiating device testing (general)
sum: Each initiating device must be tested by a method that confirms it initiates the correct signal.

title: SLC wiring methods / survivability
sum: Signaling line circuits must use required wiring methods and survivability where applicable.

title: Sleeping area low-frequency signal
sum: Where required, sleeping areas need low-frequency audible signals for awakening effectiveness.

title: Strobe synchronization
sum: Multiple visible appliances in a field of view must be synchronized.

title: Spot-type detector mounting
sum: Spot detectors must be mounted on ceilings (or walls where allowed) at listed clearances.

title: System documentation on site
sum: As-built drawings, manuals, and calculations should be available for ITM personnel.

title: Acceptance testing (IFC)
sum: Fire alarm systems must be acceptance-tested before occupancy or when required by the AHJ.

title: Fire protection systems operative
sum: Required fire protection systems must be maintained operative as a condition of occupancy.

title: Smoke detection general
sum: General rules for where and how smoke detection is applied.

title: Spot smoke detector ceilings
sum: Spot-type smoke detectors on smooth ceilings follow listed spacing.

title: Level ceilings smoke spacing
sum: Spacing reductions apply for joists, beams, and high ceilings.

title: Wall-mounted smoke detectors
sum: Wall mounting is limited; keep required clearances from ceilings.

title: Heat detection general
sum: Heat detectors must match the temperature rating and ceiling environment.

title: Spot heat detector spacing
sum: Spot heat detector spacing depends on ceiling height and construction.

title: Heat detector temperature classification
sum: Select ordinary, intermediate, or higher ratings for the ambient conditions.

title: Manual box general
sum: Manual fire alarm boxes initiate an alarm signal when activated.

title: Manual box location at exits
sum: Place boxes at required exits and travel paths so occupants can reach them.

title: Manual box mounting height
sum: Mount operable parts within the allowed height range above the floor.

title: Manual box operation force
sum: Boxes must operate with the listed force and return or latch as designed.

title: Waterflow switch retard
sum: Retard/delay settings must meet timing limits when flow is simulated.

title: Control valve supervision
sum: Supervisory devices report when a control valve leaves the normal position.

title: Duct detector application
sum: Duct smoke detection is used where required for air-moving equipment control.

title: Duct detector sampling
sum: Sampling tubes and placement must sample the airstream correctly.

title: Duct detector listing
sum: Use detectors listed for in-duct or air-duct housing applications.

title: Gas detection initiating devices
sum: Gas detectors used for fire alarm initiating must be listed and installed per instructions.

title: Other fire detectors
sum: Specialty detectors follow their listing and design documents.

title: Smoke detector guard protection
sum: Guards must not impair detection performance when used.

title: Public mode audible levels
sum: Public-mode audible signals must meet required sound pressure levels.

title: Private mode audible levels
sum: Private-mode signaling uses different level criteria than public mode.

title: Sleeping area audible
sum: Sleeping areas may require low-frequency or higher-level awakening signals.

title: Average / maximum ambient
sum: Design audible levels relative to average and maximum ambient sound.

title: Visible appliance general
sum: Visible notification appliances must be listed and of the correct candela.

title: Wall strobe location
sum: Wall-mounted strobes follow height and spacing rules for the room.

title: Ceiling strobe location
sum: Ceiling strobes use spacing based on candela and ceiling height.

title: Strobe flash rate
sum: Flash rate must stay within the listed synchronization requirements.

title: Textual visible appliances
sum: Text displays used for notification must be readable for the application.

title: Tactile notification
sum: Tactile appliances supplement audible/visible where required.

title: Exit marking audible navigation
sum: Directional sounders used for exit marking follow their chapter rules.

title: Voice notification appliances
sum: Loudspeakers used for emergency voice must support intelligibility goals.

title: Notification appliance circuits supervision
sum: NAC wiring must be supervised for integrity.

title: Equipment conditions
sum: Equipment must remain free of conditions that impair intended operation.

title: Listing of equipment
sum: Use fire alarm equipment listed for the purpose.

title: Impairment coordinator
sum: Assign responsibility for managing impairments when systems are out of service.

title: Tagging impairments
sum: Impaired systems or circuits are tagged and tracked until restored.

title: Alarm signal initiation
sum: Alarm signals must be initiated by required devices and processed by the control unit.

title: Alarm notification actuation
sum: Notification circuits actuate as required for the system type.

title: Alarm signal display
sum: Control units display alarm status distinctly for operators.

title: Alarm signal deactivation controls
sum: Access to silence/reset controls must be restricted appropriately.

title: Presignal / positive alarm sequence
sum: Special alarm sequences require AHJ approval and listed features.

title: Power supply general
sum: Primary and secondary supplies must support the system load.

title: Primary power source
sum: Dedicated branch circuits feed the fire alarm primary power where required.

title: Secondary power capacity
sum: Batteries or generators must carry the required standby and alarm load times.

title: Battery storage / marking
sum: Batteries must be marked, ventilated as needed, and protected.

title: Engine-driven generators
sum: Where used as secondary power, generators meet capacity and transfer rules.

title: Continuity of power
sum: Transfer to secondary power must not lose required functions.

title: Power supply monitoring
sum: Loss of primary power must create a trouble signal.

title: Overcurrent protection
sum: Protect fire alarm power circuits with appropriate overcurrent devices.

title: Power supply location
sum: Locate power supplies where accessible for ITM.

title: Battery calculations
sum: Keep battery calculations current with the installed load.

title: Distinct signals
sum: Alarm, supervisory, and trouble signals must be distinguishable.

title: Protected premises response
sum: Required responses (notify, shut down, unlock, etc.) must occur on alarm.

title: Notification appliance circuit performance
sum: NACs must deliver required power without overload.

title: Trouble signals
sum: Trouble conditions must be indicated and logged as required.

title: Supervisory signals
sum: Supervisory off-normal conditions must be distinct from alarms.

title: Initiating device circuit integrity
sum: IDCs are supervised for open and ground faults.

title: Signaling line circuit integrity
sum: SLCs are supervised and support required styles/classes.

title: Notification appliance circuit integrity
sum: NACs are supervised for integrity.

title: Combination systems
sum: Fire alarm functions in combination systems remain prioritized.

title: ECS general requirements
sum: Emergency communications systems provide voice and other messaging to occupants.

title: One-way ECS
sum: One-way voice systems deliver emergency messages to coverage zones.

title: Speaker circuit performance
sum: Speaker circuits support required intelligibility and supervision.

title: Two-way in-building communications
sum: Firefighter phones / two-way systems meet survivability and operation rules.

title: Mass notification systems
sum: MNS interfaces and prioritization follow ECS chapter requirements.

title: Wide-area MNS
sum: Wide-area notification has additional performance criteria.

title: Intelligibility
sum: Voice messages must be intelligible in required acoustically distinguishable spaces.

title: Message content / prioritization
sum: Emergency messages override non-emergency audio as required.

title: Elevator recall general
sum: Smoke detection initiates Phase I recall where required.

title: Elevator lobby / machine room detectors
sum: Lobby and machine-room/hoistway detection feeds recall logic.

title: Elevator shutdown
sum: Shunt-trip / power shutdown interfaces follow the design and listing.

title: Elevator warning signs / operation
sum: Related elevator fire-service features coordinate with the fire alarm.

title: Door release on alarm
sum: Hold-open doors release on alarm or smoke detection as designed.

title: Door closing / latching
sum: Released doors must close and latch to protect the opening.

title: Exit unlocking / access control
sum: Access-controlled egress doors unlock on fire alarm where required.

title: HVAC systems control
sum: Fan shutdown and damper control follow the sequence of operation.

title: Smoke control system interfaces
sum: Fire alarm interfaces to smoke control must be verified.

title: Damper control
sum: Fire/smoke dampers actuated by the fire alarm operate as required.

title: Pressure supervisory
sum: Pressure supervisory devices report off-normal sprinkler pressures.

title: Addressable device response
sum: Addressable devices must answer roll-call and report the correct address.

title: Device mapping / labels
sum: Device labels at the panel match field addresses and locations.

title: Control module operation
sum: Control modules energize/de-energize supervised outputs as programmed.

title: Monitor module operation
sum: Monitor modules report contact state changes correctly.

title: Isolator modules
sum: Fault isolators limit SLC outage scope when installed.

title: Pathway survivability
sum: Circuits needing survivability use the required level of protection.

title: Pathway classification
sum: Class A/B/N/X pathways meet their style performance.

title: Digital alarm communicator transmitters
sum: DACTs send alarm/supervisory/trouble to the supervising station.

title: Other transmission technologies
sum: Alternate communicators meet performance and supervision rules.

title: Supervising station receipt
sum: Signals must be received, displayed, and acted on at the station.

title: Communication path monitoring
sum: Single and multiple communication paths are monitored for integrity.

title: Secondary communication path
sum: Where required, a second path takes over when the primary fails.

title: Off-premises signaling
sum: Alarm signals retransmitted off-premises must be verified during testing.

title: Documentation general
sum: System documentation supports design, acceptance, and ITM.

title: Design documents
sum: Shop drawings and calculations reflect the installed system.

title: Shop drawings
sum: Shop drawings identify devices, circuits, and sequences.

title: Completion documentation
sum: Completion documents accompany new and modified systems.

title: ITM record content
sum: ITM records identify what was inspected/tested and the results.

title: ITM record retention
sum: Retain records for the AHJ and the required retention period.

title: Impairment documentation
sum: Document impairments, notifications, and restorations.

title: Acceptance test documentation
sum: Acceptance tests are documented before occupancy when required.

title: Visual inspection purpose
sum: Visual inspections look for damage, obstruction, and obvious problems.

title: Inspection frequencies table
sum: Component inspection intervals follow Chapter 14 tables.

title: Testing purpose
sum: Tests confirm devices and systems still function as intended.

title: Testing frequencies table
sum: Component test intervals follow Chapter 14 tables.

title: Maintenance purpose
sum: Maintenance keeps equipment operable between tests.

title: Notify occupants before test
sum: Notify building occupants when testing will sound alarms.

title: Notify supervising station
sum: Notify the supervising station before and after signal-producing tests.

title: System left out of service
sum: Do not leave the system impaired after testing without impairment procedures.

title: Extent of testing
sum: Test the devices and functions required for the inspection type.

title: Initial / reacceptance testing
sum: New work and modifications get reacceptance testing of affected portions.

title: Inspect for damage / obstruction
sum: Look for physical damage, paint, dust, and blocked devices.

title: Inspect mounting / location
sum: Confirm devices remain securely mounted in the correct location.

title: Smoke functional test
sum: Functionally test smoke detectors by a listed method.

title: Smoke sensitivity method
sum: Measure or verify sensitivity within the listed range.

title: Audible appliance test
sum: Confirm audible output during testing of notification appliances.

title: Visible appliance test
sum: Confirm strobe operation and candela setting during testing.

title: Sync verification
sum: Verify synchronization across visible appliances in a field of view.

title: Interface equipment test
sum: Test fire-safety control interfaces (doors, fans, dampers, elevators).

title: Control unit functions test
sum: Exercise alarm, trouble, supervisory, and reset functions at the FACP.

title: Control unit software / firmware
sum: Record software revisions during ITM when applicable.

title: Battery inspection
sum: Inspect batteries for corrosion, leaks, and date codes.

title: Battery load test
sum: Load-test secondary batteries per Chapter 14 methods.

title: Off-premises transmission test
sum: Confirm receipt of alarm/supervisory/trouble at the supervising station.

title: Maintenance procedures
sum: Follow manufacturer maintenance for cleaning and replacement.

title: Replacement parts
sum: Replace failed devices with compatible listed parts.

title: ITM personnel qualification
sum: ITM is performed by qualified persons.

title: System information availability
sum: Provide drawings and documents to ITM personnel.

title: General fire alarm (IFC)
sum: IFC general requirements for fire alarm and detection systems.

title: Fire safety functions
sum: Fire alarm systems perform fire-safety functions required by the code.

title: Initiating devices (IFC)
sum: Initiating devices are provided where IFC requires detection or manual alarm.

title: Alarm notification appliances (IFC)
sum: Occupant notification appliances meet IFC audible/visible criteria.

title: Installation (IFC)
sum: Fire alarm installation must follow NFPA 72 as referenced by IFC.

title: Zones / annunciation
sum: Zoning and annunciation meet IFC where required.

title: Access
sum: Fire alarm equipment remains accessible for inspection and maintenance.

title: Monitoring (IFC)
sum: Where required, fire alarm systems are monitored.

title: Installation of fire protection systems
sum: Fire protection systems are installed per the applicable standards.

title: Acceptance / commissioning
sum: Acceptance tests are required before use of fire protection systems.

title: Removal of or tampering with equipment
sum: Do not remove or tamper with required fire protection equipment.

title: Where required (IBC)
sum: IBC occupancy rules determine when a fire alarm system is required.

title: Occupant notification (IBC)
sum: IBC occupant notification requirements for new buildings.

title: Installation (IBC)
sum: IBC references NFPA 72 for installation requirements.

title: Monitoring of sprinkler systems
sum: Sprinkler supervisory and waterflow signals go to an approved location.

title: Alarms for sprinklers
sum: Outside or occupant alarms for sprinkler waterflow where required.

title: Initiating device accessibility
sum: Devices must remain accessible for inspection and testing.

title: Initiating device protection from damage
sum: Protect devices from mechanical damage without blocking performance.

title: Total coverage smoke
sum: Total coverage designs follow the chapter's total-coverage rules.

title: Partial coverage smoke
sum: Partial coverage is limited to the areas defined by the design.

title: Selective coverage smoke
sum: Selective coverage protects defined hazards or rooms only.

title: Telephone / paging system use
sum: Telephone or paging systems used for notification meet fire alarm rules when so used.

title: Preplanned impairment programs
sum: Preplanned impairments follow a written program with notifications.

title: Emergency impairments
sum: Emergency impairments require immediate notifications and compensatory measures.

title: Restoring impaired systems
sum: Verify operation when restoring a system after impairment.

title: Refurbishing / rebuilding
sum: Refurbished equipment follows manufacturer and listing constraints.

title: Emergency communications testing
sum: Test ECS/MNS functions on the Chapter 14 schedule.

title: Two-way communication testing
sum: Test firefighter telephones and area-of-refuge communications.

title: Actuation of fire safety functions
sum: Protected premises systems actuate required fire-safety functions.

title: Circuit styles for protected premises
sum: Use permitted circuit styles for initiating, signaling, and notification.

title: SLC wiring
sum: Install SLC wiring by the methods required for the pathway class.

title: Pathway reliability
sum: Pathways support the reliability needed for the system type.

title: Shared pathway limitations
sum: Sharing pathways with non-fire systems is limited.

title: Initiating device performance
sum: Initiating devices must perform within their listed operating range.

title: Notification appliance scope
sum: Chapter 18 covers appliances that alert occupants or staff.

title: Notification appliance listing
sum: Notification appliances must be listed for fire alarm use.

title: Impairment of systems by other work
sum: Other construction or system work must not impair fire alarm operation unnoticed.

title: In-building emergency radio / amplification
sum: ERCES impairments and supervision interact with life-safety where provided.

title: Emergency responder radio coverage
sum: IFC provisions for in-building radio coverage systems where required.

title: Audible alarms (IFC detail)
sum: IFC audible alarm criteria for occupant notification.

title: Emergency voice/alarm (IFC)
sum: IFC emergency voice/alarm communication requirements.

title: Visible alarms (IFC)
sum: IFC visible alarm criteria including accessible features.
